retrievalProfile.description: A three-tier typographic header atop a central portrait, framed by thick red vertical borders and thin white internal margins.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured square layout featuring a central photographic portrait contained within a white-bordered inner frame, flanked by two wide red vertical bars. The top section contains a black rectangular block housing three lines of high-contrast, extended sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Typographic block anchored to the top edge
Vertical red bars creating a pillar-like frame
White internal border separating the image from the red frame
Tight cropping on the subject's face
coreInvariants: Primary red, black, and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale central portrait occupying the bottom two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black typographic header block at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold title text to the subject's eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with color and image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red and yellow against high-contrast black and white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is a stylized cyan script flourish overlapping the main text block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scale and color of the same extended sans-serif family across three lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the squared, wide geometric feel of the era.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and modern look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a central portrait of a man. Add thick red vertical borders on the left and right sides. Add a thin white border inside the red bars. Leave a black rectangular space at the top for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply three lines of uppercase extended sans-serif text in the top black block. The middle line should be yellow and larger than the white lines above and below it. Add a small cyan script ampersand on the left side overlapping the middle and bottom lines.

verificationChecks: Is the text block at the very top?
Are the red borders vertical and thick?
Is the font significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the middle line of text yellow?

adjustableVariables: Color of the primary title line
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white border is consistent around the photo.
Check that the text is perfectly centered within the black block.
Verify the cyan ampersand is present as a decorative element.
Confirm the red bars reach both top and bottom edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Square layout + [Subject Portrait] + [Black Header Block] + [Extended Sans-Serif Text] + [Red Vertical Pillars]
